rows.Outcome: Your town will be randomly teleported to a new location in the target kingdom’s Badland area and will receive a 24-hour shield .
You will be automatically removed from all active group chats.
Your Arena Points will be reset to 1,000 , and your rank will be cleared.
Personal Milestone Rewards will be issued, and your ranking data will be deleted . You can participate in a new event in your new kingdom if it’s available.
Your participation will be discontinued . If you purchased a Pass, all unclaimed rewards will be reissued; otherwise, only unclaimed rewards from completed tiers will be reissued.
Your participation will immediately cease . Unclaimed rewards will be sent to your mail.
